storyCards.headline: My Life Would Suck Without You: The Breakthrough Moment
storyCards.fact:
Kelly Clarkson's "My Life Would Suck Without You" reached #1 on the Billboard Hot 100.

The song peaked at #1 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 24 weeks on the chart.

My Life Would Suck Without You was released in 2009.

"My Life Would Suck Without You" by Kelly Clarkson.

Chart story — peaked at #1 on the Hot 100.
